incident-bot: :rotating_light: Eval gate TRIP detected for model 'redwood-chat-v1.2-q' (safety threshold breach)
incident-bot: Alert summary: safety score delta +0.18 vs baseline on eval set 'customer-facing-assistant-v2' — paging on-call. Incident key: EG-20260315-4860001234
pagerduty: PagerDuty: page fired to rotation 'eng-oncall' (incident EG-20260315-4860001234). Trigger: eval_gate.safety_regression. Escalation policy: primary -> secondary in 5m.
Liang: ack
Liang: I got the page, I'm on it. First pass: is this affecting hosted and dedicated?
Maya: seeing increased safety flags on our sampling dashboard for hosted API traffic routes to redwood-chat-v1.2-q. Dedicated clusters on customer-configured pinning appear unaffected so far.
Jamal: quick check — are these from live traffic or eval-only?
QA-bot: Sampling job 486000-A ran at 16:02 UTC: 5000 live samples compared to baseline. Metrics: toxic_score mean 0.32 -> 0.50, hallucination_rate 0.04 -> 0.12.
Evelyn: confirmed live traffic impacted for routes: /v1/chat (model tag redwood-chat-v1.2-q) and canary rollout group "canary-assist-03". Early customers: 3 high-volume apps showing elevated error/complaint counts.
Liang: ok. Priority P1 due to safety regression hitting production. Actions: 1) Pause canary rollout, 2) revert routing for redwood-chat-v1.2-q to previous variant (v1.2-p), 3) notify trust & safety. Who can run the route rollback?
Maya: I can run the routing change. Using console CLI:
Maya: ```
# rollback to last known good variant
redwood routes update --route canary-assist-03 --model redwood-chat-v1.2-p --reason "eval gate safety regression"
```
Maya: starting rollback now.
incident-bot: Action logged: route update requested by Maya. Audit id: AUD-486000-77
Liang: @Maya ping when done, then let's re-run quick smoke eval against a focused prompt set. Also set temporary prefix caching off for that route to avoid cached unsafe outputs.
Maya: route update applied, traffic shifted back to v1.2-p. Console shows 100% on v1.2-p within 18s.
Jamal: running smoke eval harness (local) with prompts from 'assist_sensitive_prompts' set. Command: ```python tools/eval/run_smoke.py --model redwood-chat-v1.2-p --samples 200```
QA-bot: Smoke eval results (200 samples) posted: toxic_score mean 0.31, hallucination_rate 0.05. Back to baseline.
Liang: good. Next: open mitigation ticket for trust & safety, and run full rerun of eval pipeline on the 5k sample set. Evelyn, can you coordinate T&S outreach and customer comms?
Evelyn: on it. Drafting note to customers: short explanation + what we changed (rolled back model variant, full investigation running, will follow up with root cause). I have the customer list from Console alerting: customer A,B,C.
Jamal: capturing logs for ML team: relevant model build artifact id: build-20260310-rc7, quant profile q4_8. Attaching inference logs excerpt:
Jamal: ```
[INF] 2026-03-15T16:03:02Z request_id=abc123 model=redwood-chat-v1.2-q prompt_hash=0x7f43 safety_score=0.78
[INF] 2026-03-15T16:03:05Z request_id=abc124 model=redwood-chat-v1.2-q safety_flags=[TOXICITY_HIGH]
```
Liang: ML oncall, @Jamal can you open an SRE+ML breakout for root cause? Recommend checking recent quantization change and kernel selection commit (PR #3291). Also check latest Optimize suggested quant profile adjustments.
Evelyn: trust & safety notified, initial severity: high. Customer comms ready — waiting for confirmation of rollback (done).
Maya: rolling back triggered alert clear on sampling dashboard, toxic_score trending down. I'll keep the temp routing change in place until ML gives green.
Liang: escalation status: primary acked, secondary not needed. PagerDuty: please suppress further pages for EG-20260315-4860001234 for 90m while we validate.
pagerduty: Suppression request received. Silence applied to policy for 90m.
incident-bot: Incident update: mitigation applied (rollback to redwood-chat-v1.2-p), sampling re-run in progress, outreach to customers started. Next update in 30m or on status change.
Evelyn: filing a post-incident note in ops: "eval-gate safety regression due to variant v1.2-q — immediate rollback restored baseline. Investigating quantization/compile changes in PR #3291 and batching/kernel changes."
Liang: thanks team. If ML can reproduce locally, we can consider re-rolling with stricter eval gate thresholds and expanded prompt set coverage. For now, leaving this as P1 -> mitigated. I'll hand off to ML for root cause.
Jamal: ML will pick up. Opening ML ticket ML-486000-ROOT. Attaching sample diffs and failing prompts.
Evelyn: customer comms sent to A,B,C with mitigations and ETA for follow-up.
Liang: closing on-call loop. If anyone sees re-occurrence ping #incidents.
incident-bot: Incident EG-20260315-4860001234 marked mitigated at 16:06:05 UTC.
